references.text: The same promise of abundance from the land and security when Israel keeps God's commands, with similar expressions about eating until full
Promise that the land will yield its crops and the people will eat until full when they are obedient to God
The blessing over the land's harvest as part of the covenant promises to Israel
Call to live in the land and dwell securely, using the same Hebrew expression לָבֶטַח (lavetach)
Expression of security and rest that God gives His people
Prophetic promise that the land will yield its fruit and the people will dwell securely in their land
Promise of fullness and secure settlement in the land under God's blessing
Promise that the people will eat until full and praise the name of the Lord
Messianic promise of secure settlement under one's own vine and fig tree
